summary: Researched Enphase Energy as one immutable residential-solar, storage, and power-management security. Net-cash liquidity and positive free cash flow provide resilience, but revenue, US sell-through, and battery shipments contracted after the residential-credit expiry, while tariffs, financing, inventory commitments, and policy-timed revenue cloud normalised economics. Updated the security to watching and queued one bounded relationship review; no valuation or strategy is supportable without a fresh mark and demand stabilisation.

evidence.claim: First-quarter revenue was USD 282.9 million, US sell-through fell 48% sequentially and 18% year over year, and battery shipments declined to 103.1 MWh, while company-defined free cash flow was USD 83.0 million.

Cash, equivalents, and marketable securities were USD 930.6 million versus USD 572.5 million carrying value of debt; inventory was USD 290.7 million and component purchase obligations were approximately USD 275.0 million.

evidence.source: IRS Working Families Tax Cuts summary and Federal Reserve statement
evidence.claim: The residential clean-energy credit is unavailable for expenditures after 31 December 2025, and the federal-funds target range remained 3.5%-3.75% on 17 June 2026, preserving policy and financing headwinds for residential adoption.

daily_report_items: Enphase Energy moved to watching: net-cash liquidity and free cash flow are resilient, but US sell-through, battery shipments, and revenue contracted after the residential-credit expiry; no fresh deterministic mark or supportable valuation exists, so no strategy was proposed and one causal relationship review was queued.
